author: Yffe
content: SHIPPED — pluggable spec-intent review slot forge review (§7 line 227). review.rs: project the pre-screened DECLARATIVE spec layer (per fn: verbatim req/ens/fx + directly-referenced spec-fn declarations, NO bodies) as the 'is this what you meant?' intent-review artifact. Pre-screening (R-DEFER-9): only battery-passing (reject-free, certified incl. slag/boundary L1) contracts are intent_reviewable; a vacuous/weak/counterexample contract is flagged battery_failing, NEVER surfaced. The pluggable verdict slot: ReviewVerdict{item,aligned,note} attaches as a SEPARATE <file>.review.json record (NOT a Certificate field — mechanical vs intent never conflated). Optional --reviewer <cmd> shell-out pipes the artifact to a command + attaches the returned verdict (the pluggable integration; forge NEVER fabricates aligned). Loop: doc-author -> builder -> critic NO DIVERGENCE: no body leak (structural, fresh probe), pre-screening holds, forge never fabricates aligned, reviewer failures -> ForgeError (no panic), verdict never mutates the cert, deterministic. Commit 63d3953. workspace 358 tests, clippy/fmt clean. Not pushed.
